critical_patterns: buy_ratio between 50-65% — balanced buyers/sellers, NOT euphoric (>70% = exit liquidity)
Age 1-4h at entry is the sweet spot — not brand new, not old and dying
Vol/liq ratio 1-3x at entry — moderate momentum, NOT extreme (>10x = wash trading or already pumped)
Liquidity $30k-$80k — real money, not micro-cap rugs, not blue-chip
Quiet m5 at entry (+/-10%) — these are NOT already pumping when you buy
PumpSwap and Raydium native — post-graduation tokens, NOT bonding curve
Hold time 6-20 hours for max gains — trailing stop essential, fixed 30% TP kills the run
Multipliers 3x-143x — trailing stop is the ONLY exit that captures these moves
SILENT RUNNERS: WORLDCUP, RoyalPop, CROWDCAM never showed extreme m5 — quiet tokens that grind up over hours, not spikes
BUY RATIO 45-57% is the consistent sweet spot across all winners — RKC was 45%, WORLDCUP 53%, TROLLOPOOP 55%
OVERHEATING IS A GENUINE FILTER: TROLLOPOOP was m5=+60% every check — correctly skipped even though it ran 2315%. The scanner avoids top-chasing correctly.
FEED GAPS: Some winners never enter the lifecycle pool — suggests Helius webhook coverage could be improved for tokens that graduate quietly
AGE SWEET SPOT: WORLDCUP and TROLLOPOOP were seen at 15min correctly watchlisted. Entry at 30-60min is right — tokens that graduate and then consolidate quietly
LIQ AT PEAK 0K-15K is the consistent range for post-run successful tokens — enough to trade without impact
filter_implications: TRAILING STOP is the primary exit — fixed TP at 30% or 60% would exit at the beginning of a 1000%+ move
scout_min_age_secs=3600 (1h min) — catch tokens at 1-4h old, not brand new
scout_max_m5_pct=15 — if m5 is already +15% or more, you missed the quiet entry
b/c/d_min_buy_ratio=50, max=65 — sweet spot confirmed across ALL 8 monsters
b/c/d_min_vol_liq_ratio=1.0, max=5.0 — moderate momentum floor, cap out extreme pumps
strategy_c_min_liq_usd=30000 — floor at $30k liq keeps quality, below this = micro-cap rug zone
MAX_HOLD_PUMPSWAP must be 12h+ — BURNIE and milkers needed 14-20h holds
Do NOT require high scores — PISS scored 3, NoHat scored 4, still 18x-22x
recommended_config_changes: trailing_stop_pct=0.12 — 12% trail gives room on parabolic moves
scout_min_age_secs=3600 — 1h minimum, monsters were 1-4h old at entry
scout_max_m5_pct=15 — quiet entry filter, skip if already running hard
